items.title: DeepSeek added vision to V4-Flash
items.oneliner: DeepSeek shipped V4-Flash-Vision-Exp with mixed text-image APIs, pushing multimodal agents closer to frontier performance at lower cost.

items.title: NVIDIA claimed a perfect ARC-AGI-3 score
items.oneliner: NVIDIA says AVO solved all 183 public ARC-AGI-3 levels, a flashy autonomy milestone with obvious overfitting caveats.

items.title: Qwen3-TTS hit sub-50 millisecond latency
items.oneliner: Nari Labs got Qwen3-TTS below 50 ms first-audio and about $2 per million characters, making real-time voice cheaper.

items.title: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol pricing
items.oneliner: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol by more than 20%, confirming frontier model competition is now a pricing war too.

items.title: Neglected telecom DNS exposed military calls
items.oneliner: A researcher hijacked forgotten e164.arpa zones and logged hundreds of thousands of calls, including military traffic.

items.title: Cloudflare revisited Spectre on Workers
items.oneliner: Cloudflare confirmed remote Spectre leakage remained measurable on Workers, then tightened isolation before attackers did.

items.title: Meta faced a child privacy trial
items.oneliner: California and 28 states want up to $200 billion from Meta, a case that could force product redesigns.

items.title: NVIDIA reportedly pursued Poolside for $6 billion
items.oneliner: NVIDIA's reported $6 billion Poolside deal shows model talent and code agents are now strategic infrastructure assets.

items.title: Rust enabled its next trait solver
items.oneliner: Rust turned on its next trait solver in nightly after four years, fixing 200-plus issues and reshaping compiler internals.

items.title: Rust Glancer cut LSP memory drastically
items.oneliner: Rust Glancer targets under 100 MB RAM, a reminder that developer tools do not have to eat a laptop.
